text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer <username>.
How's Satono Crown's training going?
Smooth sailing?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right~? After all, it's *that* Satono Crown.
I can easily picture her breezing through her training.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"That also means the outside pressure
must be far greater than usual, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In all my time training Satono Crown,
I have never once felt any pressure
from her family.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. I see, I see~
You've got some real guts, kiddo.
Yep! Keep giving it your all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the debut race.
The training course was more lively
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"One more tune-up race before the Make Debut.
Many Umamusume think that way."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
The uphill course is booked for ten minutes from now,
so let's do a light warm-up and—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Kura-chaaaaann!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction of the voice that came flying over vigorously,
there stood her classmate Umamusume, Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to go do a tandem run with Cheval-chan!
Kura-chan, wanna join usssss?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, eh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Panicking beside her is Cheval Grand. She is also a contemporary of Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
! Thanks for the invite!
Unfortunately, I already have plans!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see!!
Catch you next time, then!
choice_data_list: You classmates really get along well.
You classmates really get along well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Because Kitasan is among this year's debut class."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She is boundlessly dedicated and has a magnetic charm.
Before you know it, everyone opens their hearts to her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The girls who stand at the center of an era
often turn out to be that type.
choice_data_list: ...I believe you're the one who'll define an era, though.
...Though I think you're the one who will shape the era.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: My!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind you falling head over heels for me,
but make sure you look around and keep an objective perspective too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I believe I'll win too, but...
this generation has "that girl" as well, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Look at that. She's trying to make history again.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, her opponent's an upperclassman from a generation above, right?
Even if she's a daughter of that family... to think she'd cross the line first.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And with such unrefined running, too...
...She truly is a terrifying prospect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Duramente"—
There isn't a single Trainer who doesn't know that name.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A prodigy sent into the Umamusume world by an athletic dynasty that has swept the glory of every sport.
Her abilities are exceptionally highâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even Satono Crown had tasted
defeat in a mock race once before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Good work, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You heading to the uphill course too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I have reserved time after this... but.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind extending it,
as long as you pick me as your running partner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chatter chatter chatter!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Satono Crown makes that proposal,
the gazes of the surrounding Trainers turn even sharper.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown!
Aside from that match against Duramente,
you've pretty much won every mock race, haven't you?!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente and Crown!?
Huh... I guess Crown really is someone special to Duramente after all?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Crown has first-rate acceleration and body control.
Between the very top of this generation, which one will take the win...?
choice_data_list: (…! So many people all at once—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, curious gazes surround them.
All around them is excitement and anticipation for the two.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"That also means the outside pressure
must be far greater than usual, but..."
choice_data_list: (What my senior was talking about was—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just once is within acceptable limits.
Any more than that would be overwork.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks!
...Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just look at how much I've grown
from these past few months of training with you. Watch closely, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Dura & Crown
text_block_list.text:
—...Hah!!
—...Yaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Trainers
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that!? Did you see them!?
Those two were unbelievable!!
I mean, Satono Crown...!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Um, Chief!
What race do you think Crown
will run in after her debut!?

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it normally, she should challenge graded races, right?
For someone like her, snatching one or two graded races
during her Junior year should be a breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. There is no way she wouldn't draw attention.
There is no way victory wouldn't be expected of her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown is an Umamusume of premier talent,
whose abilities no one around her ever doubts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume whom I cannot
allow to lose—simply because of my own direction.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...
Being able to concentrate until you lose sight of your surroundings
is one of your good points, too, though~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the notebook, I review the compiled strategy.
All that's left is to convey the debut race plan to Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This past week, I've added dozens of additional proposals. Plans to bring out her abilities and lead her to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From these strategies, I just need to choose
the optimal one today based on the field's condition
and running styles. If I do that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Give me three minutes of your time ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Just watch me.
This will be over in no time, customer♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Stare closely at this coin
between you and me—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just a little tweaking, and——...
'And she went missing,' as they say.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, magic.
I practiced an advanced trick!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And so, here's a question. Why do you think my magic trick worked?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but...
let's be a little more flexible with our thinking.
The answer is surprisingly simple.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because I practiced thoroughly.
...Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: At night, secretly in the room, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —And then, all that built up over time to support my "success."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Then our race today should be a success too, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—You put in the effort too.
Coming up with training methods tailored just for me, day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Should I take her out occasionally to lift her spirits?
I put the schedule together while pondering questions like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
All the effort and preparation we've put in together
will never betray us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Whether in racing or in magic,
those two things are all you need
to make a 'miracle' happen."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Take a good look, Trainer.
At yourself, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Are you really someone who puts in so little effort that I need to worry about you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so at all! Come on!
Give me the absolute best plan you've come up with!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The magic show begins♪
